review_comments: Do we have a test for the new user name (if new token)? If not, should we add that?
It's just the name used in the frontend?

Yes, but we obviously care about it. We can just add an assert on this line:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/3276666457c985738ffb255fd1e959c4d58433db/tests/components/hassio/test_init.py#L179
That tests when an existing user name is migrated. It doesn't test this line where we create a new user with a name.
